proposal.blind_spot: Current metrics show DRAM is busy but cannot distinguish true bandwidth saturation from latency-limited execution with too few resident warps or too little memory-level parallelism, so the optimizer cannot tell whether to raise occupancy/loads-in-flight or only reduce bytes.

rationale.sm__warps_active.avg.pct_of_peak_sustain: HIGH -> occupancy is fine; increase per-warp memory-level parallelism (larger per-thread tiles, unrolled/vectorized loads) instead of adding warps / LOW -> raise occupancy via larger num_warps or BLOCK and lower register pressure to hide latency and push idle DRAM headroom
rationale.smsp__warp_issue_stalled_long_scoreboard: HIGH -> warps wait on global loads, so unroll loops, load multiple elements per thread, and hoist/prefetch tl.loads to overlap latency / LOW -> loads are not the stall; stop tuning load patterns and instead investigate write traffic or issue efficiency
